body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at e4b58abe:
- packages/quartermaster/lib/registry.mjs:23 imports `isPlainObject` from `@adlc/core`, but packages/quartermaster/package.json declares no dependencies. A standalone install of the published tarball fails at import with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for '@adlc/core'; workspace hoisting hides it inside the monorepo.
- packages/autopilot/lib/quota.mjs:40 and packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs:280 keep local `isPlainObject` copies although core exports one, so the definitions disagree (core rejects class instances) and a core fix does not reach them.
- packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/verdict.mjs:75-79: computeVerdict applies its zero-candidate refusal only when `candidatesClassified` is supplied; an omitted field falls through to the clean verdict (exit 0). It also reads three alias fields no caller passes.
- packages/flail-detector/lib/signals.mjs:20: `/(?:^|\s)(?:Writing|Editing|Created)\s+([^\s]+)/i` matches the verb after any whitespace, so Claude Code's `File created successfully at: <path>` tool result yields the path `successfully`. Three healthy Write calls give exit 2 (edit-churn) and, with --scope, a scope violation per write.
- `coldstart --all` (packages/coldstart/bin/coldstart.mjs:66-74) and merge-forecast (bin/merge-forecast.mjs:121-123) exit 1 on an empty or all-completed ticket store, but no test asserts either branch.
- TicketService.planCreateBatch (packages/tickets/lib/service.mjs:152-155) runs the archive and manifest-rail guards per ticket, but no test covers either guard, a stale-snapshot apply, or the store-scoped evidence entry; removing a guard keeps the suite green.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Tests run per package with `npm test -w packages/<pkg>` from the worktree root; repo guards with `node --test scripts/test/<file>`. Temp fixtures use `tmp(t)` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`, except in packages/tickets (core imports tickets), which uses mkdtempSync with rmSync in finally. Adding a dependency edits package-lock.json: run `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`. packages/gate-fuzzing/test/verdict.test.mjs and independence-required.test.mjs are not rails; their computeVerdict calls must pass `candidatesClassified` once it is required.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Every packages/* member declares, in dependencies or peerDependencies, each `@adlc/*` package imported by its shipped (non-test) code. quartermaster and init declare `@adlc/core` at the workspace version.
2. No package other than core and tickets defines its own `isPlainObject`; autopilot and init import core's.
3. computeVerdict: when no defeat was confirmed, a `candidatesClassified` that is missing or not a non-negative safe integer yields `{exitCode: 2, summary: 'inconclusive', inconclusive: true}`. `allowEmpty` turns only a verified zero into exit 0. Confirmed defeats are reported as today whatever the count. Only `candidatesClassified` is read.
4. flail-detector's verb pattern matches only at the start of a line, after optional indentation and log prefixes (timestamps, bracketed fields, upper-case level names INFO/WARN/WARNING/DEBUG/TRACE/ERROR/NOTICE, each optionally followed by ':'). It never crosses a newline. Synthetic `Writing <path>` lines from structured tool calls keep working. Update packages/flail-detector/README.md and make the same edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/flail-detector.mdx.
5. Tests pin: coldstart --all exit 1 with `no active tickets found (all tickets are completed)` and with `no tickets found in ticket file`; the matching merge-forecast exits; planCreateBatch ARCHIVE_COLLISION, RAIL_COVERS_MANIFEST, STALE_SNAPSHOT with the store hash unchanged, and exactly one `ticket-mutation` entry with operation `batch-create`, ticketId null, bindingScope `store` and no `ticketIds`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Undeclared @adlc imports are rejected repo-wide and none remain. verify: `node --test scripts/test/workspace-deps-declared.test.mjs`
- AC2 No local isPlainObject copy outside core and tickets; autopilot rejects a class instance as a limits entry. verify: `node --test scripts/test/core-helper-copies.test.mjs packages/autopilot/test/quota-plain-object.test.mjs`
- AC3 computeVerdict fails closed on an unknown count. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/verdict-count-required.test.mjs`
- AC4 Prose verbs and the Write tool result are not read as paths; a three-Write transcript is clean. verify: `node --test packages/flail-detector/test/prose-verb-paths.test.mjs`
- AC5 Empty and all-completed stores exit 1 in coldstart --all and merge-forecast. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/all-completed.test.mjs packages/merge-forecast/test/no-active-tickets.test.mjs`
- AC6 planCreateBatch guards, stale apply and evidence are pinned. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/batch-guards.test.mjs`
- AC7 Package suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/quartermaster -w packages/autopilot -w packages/init -w packages/gate-fuzzing -w packages/flail-detector -w packages/coldstart -w packages/merge-forecast -w packages/tickets`
- AC8 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "must open the line" packages/flail-detector/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/flail-detector.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: the isPlainObject copy in packages/tickets/lib/pointer.mjs and the generated plugin copies derived from it; changing flail-detector's `file_path` pattern or parse-log's extraction; gate-fuzzing loop accounting of candidatesEvaluated; any behaviour change in coldstart, merge-forecast or TicketService (tests only).
title: misc packages: declare @adlc deps, fail closed on unknown gate-fuzzing counts, anchor flail-detector verbs, pin untested exits
